logline: When Alexander returns to the cottage gravely wounded and soaked in blood, Juliana tends to his injuries, leading to an intimate confrontation where their unspoken feelings and scarred pasts finally collide.
continuity_notes: Follows the ominous revelation from Episode 9 of rumors circulating about a scarred war veteran, cutting directly to the secluded cottage where Alexander arrives bearing fresh wounds.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium profile shot of Juliana sitting at a wooden table beside the glowing fireplace, reading an old herbal medicine book.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana quietly studies the botanical illustrations by firelight, a bundle of fresh dried herbs resting on the table.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: A heavy wooden door suddenly creaks and bangs open in the quiet cottage.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana jerks her head up from the book, startled by the sudden intrusion.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium wide shot framing the doorway as Alexander stands framed in the dark threshold, panting heavily, his hand pressed against his blood-soaked chest.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana rising swiftly from her chair, shock and terror flashing across her face.

events.label: JULIANA (Alarmed, Breathless)
events.content: "Alexander!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander struggling to breathe, clutching his bloodied coat over his chest.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Gruff, Strained)
events.content: "It is nothing."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana hurriedly stepping toward him across the stone floor.

events.label: JULIANA (Urgent, Worried)
events.content: "There is blood running down your arm."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium profile two-shot as Alexander stands rigid while Juliana confronts him.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Stiff, Dismissive)
events.content: "A cut from the tenant fields."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot of the hearth room as Juliana firmly points toward a wooden armchair beside the fire.

events.label: JULIANA (Commanding, Resolute)
events.content: "Sit down."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana's determined, unyielding expression.

events.label: JULIANA (Stern)
events.content: "Now."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Alexander reluctantly lowering his heavy frame onto the chair in front of the fire.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium tracking shot following Juliana as she brings a wooden washbowl, fresh cloth, and an earthen jar of ointment to the foot of his chair.

events.label: JULIANA (Gentle, Insistent)
events.content: "I need to see the wound."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle close-up of Alexander looking up at her stubbornly.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Defiant)
events.content: "It is only a scratch."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana crossing her arms over her chest, eyeing him with quiet defiance.

events.label: JULIANA (Sarcastic, Challenging)
events.content: "Then removing your shirt should not trouble you."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot as Alexander stares at her for a beat before pushing himself up from the chair and shedding his heavy leather coat.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana observing him with guarded anticipation.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up shot of Alexander pulling his dark shirt over his head, revealing his muscular torso crisscrossed with jagged battle scars and fresh bleeding lacerations.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight pan over the scarred, wounded flesh along his chest and ribs.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in horror and deep pity.

events.label: JULIANA (Whispering, Distressed)
events.content: "Dear God."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium wide shot as Alexander sinks back into the chair, exhausted, while Juliana slowly kneels before him on the stone floor.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up macro shot of Juliana's trembling fingers hovering tenderly over the raised, jagged scar across Alexander's chest.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her eyes softened with profound empathy.

events.label: JULIANA (Soft, Sorrowful)
events.content: "You have suffered terribly."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander's weathered, scarred face gazing down at her with quiet stoicism.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Quiet, Somber)
events.content: "It is over."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana dipping a linen cloth into the water bowl.

events.label: JULIANA (Gentle)
events.content: "Your scars disagree."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up shot of Juliana carefully dabbing the damp cloth against the bloody cut on Alexander's shoulder.

events.label: JULIANA (Tender)
events.content: "Does it hurt?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander trying not to wince under her touch.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Gruff)
events.content: "Not much."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, amused by his stubborn pride.

events.label: JULIANA (Playful, Whispering)
events.content: "You are a terrible liar."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up of Juliana's fingers taking a dollop of green herbal salve and smoothing it gently over his shoulder wound.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up over Juliana's shoulder looking at Alexander, who stares intently into her face, oblivious to the wound.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana looking up from his shoulder into his eyes, sensing the intensity of his gaze.

events.label: JULIANA (Soft, Breathless)
events.content: "Why do you look at me like that?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander, his voice deep and laden with restrained emotion.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Intense, Sincere)
events.content: "Because you are looking at me."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana looking back down at his shoulder to hide her growing fluster, applying the salve carefully.

events.label: JULIANA (Flustered, Whispering)
events.content: "Hold still."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Alexander leaning closer to her, his breathing heavy.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Husky)
events.content: "I am holding still."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up two-shot of their faces drawing mere inches apart in the warm firelight.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Whispering, Vulnerable)
events.content: "Perhaps it is your hand."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander's large, rough hands reaching up and gently enveloping Juliana's slender hands, bringing them against his bare chest over his racing heart.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up shot of Alexander gazing into Juliana's eyes with raw, unmasked devotion.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Deep, Emotional)
events.content: "Your touch is the only medicine that has ever eased my pain."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up shot holding on Juliana's wide, luminous blue eyes, completely captivated and overwhelmed by his confession, the firelight dancing across their intertwined hands as the scene lingers and fades.
